FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A33
The knowledge and skills tests may be taken in either order. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A33
Skills tests may be scheduled only during daylight and acceptable weather. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A33
Twelve or fewer errors is the skills-test passing score. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A33
A failed skills test requires a three-day wait before retesting. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A33
A skills-test retake requires paying both the county and examiner fees again. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A33
A person who has never been licensed must take a skills test. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A33
A learner younger than seventeen who completed approved training and supervised instruction must take the skills test when eligible. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A33
An instruction-permit holder aged seventeen or older needs a skills test to become licensed. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A33
An applicant whose vision does not meet the minimum standard must take a skills test. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A33
A recurring skills-test requirement may result from a medical or vision condition. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A33
A foreign-license applicant must take a skills test unless a reciprocity agreement applies. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R12 | anchor: A33
A non-commercial Idaho or other-state license expired at least twenty-five months requires a skills test. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R13 | anchor: A33
A skills test is required for an applicant with a mental or physical impairment that might affect safe vehicle operation. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R14 | anchor: A33
A skills test is required when a county agent has concerns about an applicant's ability to drive safely, regardless of prior licensing, experience or age. [A33]
Source: [A33 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R15 | anchor: A34
Third-party contractors administer Idaho’s Class D skills tests. [A34]
Source: [A34 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R16 | anchor: A34
An applicant needing or wanting a restricted skills test must notify the examiner. [A34]
Source: [A34 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R17 | anchor: A34
A restricted skills test is for an applicant unable to drive outside existing or proposed restrictions, or an applicant who wants to drive only between specified locations. [A34]
Source: [A34 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R18 | anchor: A34
An applicant seeking an unrestricted license must complete the whole test route without modifications. [A34]
Source: [A34 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R19 | anchor: A34
An applicant considering a restricted skills test must discuss the options with the examiner before taking the test. [A34]
Source: [A34 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R20 | anchor: A34
A skills-test applicant must bring photo identity evidence, such as a state-issued photo identification card or driver license, an instruction or supervised instruction permit, a passport, a school identification card or a yearbook. [A34]
Source: [A34 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R21 | anchor: A34
A non-owner using a vehicle for testing must give the examiner the owner’s written permission or permission spoken in person. [A34]
Source: [A34 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R22 | anchor: A34
Permission to use the test vehicle cannot be given over the telephone. [A34]
Source: [A34 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R23 | anchor: A35
The test vehicle must carry current insurance evidence on paper or in digital form. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R24 | anchor: A35
An SR22 does not qualify as skills-test proof of insurance. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R25 | anchor: A35
The test vehicle must carry current registration signed by the registrant, rather than a photocopy. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R26 | anchor: A35
A skills-test receipt is required for identity verification only when no state-issued credential is supplied, and photo identification is still necessary. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R27 | anchor: A35
If applicable, an applicant with a medical-caution reevaluation or skills-test requirement must bring ITD's Skills Test Evaluation Form to the skills test. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R28 | anchor: A35
Skills-test passengers are normally prohibited, and each permitted exception passenger must be at least eighteen, carry valid identification and sign the liability waiver. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R29 | anchor: A35
One parent or legal guardian may accompany a skills-test applicant aged seventeen or younger if the passenger is at least eighteen, has valid identification and signs the liability waiver. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R30 | anchor: A35
A translator may accompany a skills-test applicant without translator certification or a driver license if the translator is at least eighteen, has valid identification and signs the liability waiver. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R31 | anchor: A35
The applicant is responsible for obtaining a translator when one is needed for the skills test. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R32 | anchor: A35
A law-enforcement officer may accompany a current inmate during a skills test if the officer is at least eighteen, has valid identification and signs the liability waiver. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R33 | anchor: A35
When requested, a religious missionary companion may accompany the skills-test applicant if the companion is at least eighteen, has valid identification and signs the liability waiver. [A35]
Source: [A35 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec03-R34 | anchor: A36
Before the skills test, the examiner checks the passenger door and seatbelt, required mirrors, windshield, tires and dashboard indicators against Idaho and ITD standards. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R35 | anchor: A36
Skills-test tires must have at least two thirty-seconds of an inch of tread. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R36 | anchor: A36
The handbook's printed default skills-test inspection schedule disallows studded tires from May first through September thirtieth. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R37 | anchor: A36
A dealer-plated vehicle may be used for a skills test only by a dealer or full-time salesperson who proves that status with a state dealer identification card. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R38 | anchor: A36
A rental car cannot be used for the skills test by an unlicensed applicant or one younger than twenty-five. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R39 | anchor: A36
A test vehicle that fails safety standards requires rescheduling with a roadworthy vehicle or after repairs. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R40 | anchor: A36
The applicant must locate or show the examiner that the driver door and seatbelt, brake lights, turn signals, headlights, windshield wipers, hazard lights, driver window, horn, parking brake and defroster or defogger work properly. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R41 | anchor: A36
The applicant must demonstrate each of the three arm signals during the vehicle-knowledge inspection. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R42 | anchor: A36
At most three misses in the vehicle-knowledge inspection are allowed before proceeding to driving. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R43 | anchor: A37
The skills test includes business and residential roads, curves, freeway driving, lane changes, parking lots, left and right turns, U-turns and stall and curb parking. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R44 | anchor: A37
Skills-test scoring includes vehicle control, observation, spacing, signaling, speed, stopping, lane position, parking and right of way. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R45 | anchor: A37
A critical driving error automatically fails the skills test and ends it immediately. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R46 | anchor: A37
Missing the same scored skill five or more times is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R47 | anchor: A37
Parking more than eighteen inches from the curb while impeding traffic is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R48 | anchor: A37
After passing, the applicant must deliver the examiner’s sealed results envelope to the county DMV without opening it. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R49 | anchor: A37
Results in an opened or altered test envelope are held until ITD verifies and approves them. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R50 | anchor: A37
After a failed skills test, the examiner sends the failed result to ITD for the driving record. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R51 | anchor: A37
Driving authority begins only after the passing skills result is recorded and the driver’s license is issued. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R52 | anchor: A37
Controlled and uncontrolled intersections, railroad crossings and roundabouts are included in the skills test. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R53 | anchor: A37
A dangerous action during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R54 | anchor: A37
Disobeying an emergency or safety vehicle during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R55 | anchor: A37
Disobeying police or safety personnel during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R56 | anchor: A37
Disregarding a traffic sign or signal during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R57 | anchor: A37
Driving onto a curb or sidewalk during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R58 | anchor: A37
Examiner intervention or disobedience to the examiner during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R59 | anchor: A37
A lane violation during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R60 | anchor: A37
Passenger interference during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R61 | anchor: A37
Speeding during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R62 | anchor: A37
Striking an object during the skills test is a critical driving error. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R63 | anchor: A36
The skills-test windshield must have no cracks or obstructions. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R64 | anchor: A36
The test vehicle must have a rear-view mirror or both side mirrors. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R65 | anchor: A36
Critical dashboard warning lights or gauges must not be illuminated on the skills-test vehicle. [A36]
Source: [A36 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec03-R66 | anchor: A32
The handbook warns that online practice tests do not accurately represent Idaho knowledge tests, apart from ITD’s own website sample questions. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-R67 | anchor: A37
The skills test scores how the driver accelerates and slows the vehicle. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R68 | anchor: A37
Driver attentiveness is assessed during the skills test. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R69 | anchor: A37
Skills-test scoring considers whether stops are complete or unnecessary. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R70 | anchor: A37
Steering control is assessed during the skills test. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec03-R71 | anchor: A37
Skills-test scoring includes traffic checks. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0037]
